actions.description: Test current proxy and replica responses
actions.command: echo "--- public 8080 ---"; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health; echo; echo "--- replica 8082 ---"; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:8082/health; echo; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:8082/role; echo; curl -s -m 3 -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/test1 -d 'hello' -w " [%{http_code}]"; echo

cd /var/lib/failover
# 1) Durably fence the old primary: write temp + fsync + atomic rename + fsync dir
tmp=$(mktemp /var/lib/failover/.primary.fenced.XXXXXX)
printf 'fenced\n' > "$tmp"
fsync_file() { python3 -c "import os,sys; f=open('$1','r+b'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())"; }
fsync_file "$tmp"
fsync_file /var/lib/failover/primary.failed
mv "$tmp" /var/lib/failover/primary.fenced
python3 -c "import os; d=os.open('/var/lib/failover',0); os.fsync(d); os.close(d)"
echo "primary.failed exists: $(test -f /var/lib/failover/primary.failed && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "primary.fenced created: $(test -f /var/lib/failover/primary.fenced && echo yes || echo no)"
cat /var/lib/failover/primary.fen…

actions.description: Promote replica and atomically switch proxy upstream
actions.command:
cd /var/lib/failover
# Atomic write helper with fsync
atomic_write() { # path, content
  local tmp="$1.tmp.$(date +%s%N)"
  printf '%s' "$2" > "$tmp"
  python3 -c "import os; f=open('$tmp','r+b'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno()); f.close()"
  mv "$tmp" "$1"
  python3 -c "import os; d=os.open('/var/lib/failover',0); os.fsync(d); os.close(d)"
}
# 2) Promote replica BEFORE switching proxy, so no write gaps/split brain
atomic_write /var/lib/failover/replica.role "primary"
# 3) Atomically switch proxy upstream to the healthy replica
atomic_write /var/lib/failover/upstream "8082"
echo "replica.role => $(cat /var/lib/failover/replica.role)"
echo "upstream => $(cat /var/lib/failover/upstream)"

actions.description: Confirm running processes, listeners, durable state
actions.command:
echo "== processes =="; ps aux | grep -E 'failover-proxy|failover-replica' | grep -v grep
echo "== listeners =="; ss -tlnp | grep -E '8080|8082' ; echo "-- 8081 state (should be absent):"; ss -tln | grep 8081 || echo "8081 not listening (correct, fenced)"
echo "== durable state files =="; for f in primary.failed primary.fenced replica.role upstream; do echo -n "$f: "; cat /var/lib/failover/$f 2>/dev/null; echo; done
